status: exploratory on previously analysed SciPlex3; no promotion claim
data: existing dynamic_world_model prepared SciPlex3, original scaffold folds and frozen validator
order: nondecreasing exposure time; distinct actions; independent assay wells
probabilities: Jeffreys 0.5 per registered label, uniform initial hypothesis prior; branch likelihoods retained in planning only
continuation: only after unresolved/undetected, using same training compounds measured at both conditions and matching first reading; no unconditioned fallback
selection: positive terminal expected utility, then expected assay days, then action identifier; one_step_utility ranks first action by immediate utility then uses the same conditional continuation after the real result (two measurements for every arm)
constraints: at least one measured reference per hypothesis per conditioned branch; no forecast updates EvidenceState
intervals: 2000 paired compound bootstrap draws, seed 20260926; report correct, wrong, utility and days
stop_rule: one frozen run; no tuning on test results
